نشلل (form I)
# نَشْلَلْ (našlal) /naʃ.lal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of شَلَّ (šalla)
# نَشْلُلْ (našlul) /naʃ.lul/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of شَلَّ (šalla)
# نُشْلَلْ (nušlal) /nuʃ.lal/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of شَلَّ (šalla) and شُلَّ (šulla)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
